prs.description: # Summary [Required] _Describe What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant. See GitHub best practices for reference [^1]._ * finance OKRs: to be able to do verticals reporting (i.e. based on marketplace category of item, to determine the performance by marketplace verticals. * this was requested by @Samantava, to incorporate these verticals in for reporting. ([example on looker](https://looker.vinted.net/looks/12039)) risks: * this is an incremental model. if marketplace changes the way they want to map categories reporting, changes will not be automatically propogated. a full refresh is required to update the results. * this depends on a marketplace model, which is dependent on a transactional model. this means that the model itself runs late (at 02:30:57 UTC, see [airflow](https://dwh-scheduler.int.vinted.com/dags/programs_daily/grid?search=programs_daily&task_id=dimensions.dim_transaction_verticals&dag_run_id=scheduled__2025-05-19T00:20:00+00:00)). there are two risks: * the critical path will lengthen. currently, `dim_prep_shipments_leg_information` runs at 01:18:24 UTC, but now can only run ~1.5h later after the marketplace model completes. this lengthening is still tolerable as all models will still complete comfortably before the SLO of 06h UTC. * marketplace models are unstable, have a tendency to fail. to mitigate this, we should make the model a soft dependency. * _(due to the critical path being lengthened, a conscious decision was made not to add it to network domain's models, unless the network domain absolutely needs it. this is because there are many dependencies on `fct_{status}_carrier_legs`, and lengthening the critical path is undesirable. therefore, the impact is only going to be on vgo_finance here)_ * as understood, `grf_finance` also reports on the vertical already. there is a need to align with them on which source they're using to make sure that we're using the same source of information. # To do list _Describe manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`, updating Confluence docs, sending out slack comms etc.)._ create samples ```sh dbt run-operation create_sample --args '{source: dim_transaction_verticals, prod_bq_project: dv-mkp-prgm-prod}' --target dev_samples; prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ **what is the context?** * originates from a shipping pricing request to have a profit and loss view - consisting of group-level costs (i.e. marketplace revenue, vintedgo costs) - more information in this [google document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dr4rTjPw7Dt8rnnoZf8AG096KANhJyRyeXXs0oRaBYQ/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.y5lw5wujvq8e). * this mart is not served by other use-cases, for example, `mrt_shipping_revenue_vs_costs` from group finance only considers marketplace revenue and marketplace cost (i.e. what vintedgo bills to marketplace), and `mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_vs_revenue` from VGo finance only considers vintedgo revenue and costs. therefore, this model needed to be built. * we agreed that shipping pricing will own it, and that because shipping pricing does not currently have a data space, this shall exist in the space which shipping pricing is using: `dv-mkp-mrkt` (i.e. marketing). **what is introduced?** * these models do the following: * consolidate actual costs (based on carrier invoices received) * consolidate expected costs (based on price list information) * consolidate marketplace revenue (based on invoice lines), allocate them by carrier leg (one transaction can have more than one shipment) proportionately. * of which, the granularity for doing so is `transaction_id`, `shipment_carrier_leg_id`, `currency` in all three models, and the finally joined model. **where can i see sample data?** the final table is available in the marketing data space. ``` select * from `dv-mkp-mrkt-sb.dev_jeremy_chia.mrt_shipping_profit_loss_by_carrier_leg` ``` component tables are available in VGo finance's data space. not all reviewers may have access to this, and if access is required, please let @jeremychia know and i will transfer these tables to the marketing sandbox: ``` `dv-vgo-fin-sb.dev_jeremy_chia.mrt_prep_shipping_pricing__actual_costs` `dv-vgo-fin-sb.dev_jeremy_chia.mrt_prep_shipping_pricing__estimated_costs` `dv-vgo-fin-sb.dev_jeremy_chia.mrt_prep_shipping_pricing__marketplace_revenue` ``` # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ * will follow up with another PR to do an aggregate on this mart `mrt__shipping_profit_loss_by_carrier_leg`. # reviews.body:
hey, I added a few comments that you can feel free to ignore and resolve if they don't make sense at this point :)
I think the modelling makes sense, splitting pre-processing of the different sources in prep marts makes it much easier to understand than having everything one mart.
One thing that I would like to stress though is the fact that we should use only facts and dims as sources for those models, according to this [RFC](https://vinted.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DPV2/pages/30028234762/2025-03-12+Dataverse+Sharing+Interfaces).
all the documentation looks good to me, very nice job with the simplification of the code of the final mart. I just added some suggestions for the scheduler alerts reporting.

prs.description: # Summary [Required] _Describe What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant. See GitHub best practices for reference [^1]._ ## context: * @Laura-Sn had notified us that there were royal mail invoice rows which had `null` invoice_cost_description`s. * on deeper investigation, we found that there were supplementary charges being applied, and these rows did not have `servicename`, which was used for determining the `invoice_cost_description`. see tabulation: ```sql select servicename, servicecode, coalesce(servicename, servicecode), count(*) from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.carrier_invoices.royal_mail` group by all; ``` ## adjustments to staging layer > [!NOTE] > therefore, in the staging layer, we will use the service code as an alternative for the invoice cost description. > ```sql > coalesce(servicename, servicecode) as invoice_cost_description > ``` ## adjustments to dim_prep for latest records * because there can be multiple invoice cost descriptions we're expecting, the deduplication logic in `dim_prep_royal_mail_invoices_latest_records` needs to be adjusted. * the deduplication is by `invoice_tracking_code`, and `invoice_cost_description`. ## adjustments to dim_prep for unpivoting costs * in some cases, there are spoilages. this is what the dim_prep for unpivoting costs does. * in the case of supplementary costs, they are added as one more row. they can be taken into account regularly. * however, for supplementary costs, weight and country code is not present. therefore, this needs to be propogated with information which we already have. ```sql select * from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.carrier_invoices.royal_mail` where trackingnumber = "TQ764828261GB" order by transactiondate, spoilton; ``` _in this example, the country code is missing_ ## putting it together with an example i tried to look for examples where there is spoilage, and also supplementary costs, and found a few examples: ```sql with count_details as ( select trackingnumber, countif( servicecode = "RM-Supplement-InsufficientPostage" ) as count_insufficient_postage, countif(servicecode = "RM-Supplement-Oversized") as count_oversized, countif( servicename = "Royal Mail Tracked 48 with Signature" ) as count_with_signature, countif(servicename = "Royal Mail Tracked 48") as count_regular, countif(spoilton is not null) as count_refund, from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.carrier_invoices.royal_mail` group by all ) select * from count_details where count_refund > 0 and count_regular > 0 and (count_oversized > 0 or count_insufficient_postage > 0) ; /*

```sql
with

        from `dv-vgo-fin-prod`.`facts`.`fct_no_spec_file_invoice_rows`
        where invoice_id = "3125000589"
    ),

    -- we only want to see the most common country code (finance specification)
    get_most_common_country_code_by_invoice_no_spec as (
        select
            invoice_id,
            invoice_date,
            invoice_carrier_code,
            invoice_carrier_code_shipment_level,

            invoice_currency,
            invoice_from_country_code,
            invoice_to_country_code
        from no_spec_invoice_rows
        group by all
        qualify
            row_number() over (
                partition by
                    invoice_id, invoice_date, invoice_carrier_code, invoice_currency
                order by count(*) desc
            )
            = 1
    ),

    agg_no_spec_invoice_rows as (
        select

        from agg_no_spec_invoice_rows as agg
        left join
            get_most_common_country_code_by_invoice_no_spec as most_common_country_code
            using (invoice_id, invoice_date, invoice_carrier_code, invoice_currency)
    ),

    /*
        Invoices with Specification

    invoices_with_spec_file as (
        select
            -- columns which are used from mart_prep_invoice_rows_wide_categories
            invoice_id,
            invoice_carrier_code,
            invoice_currency,

            illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            other_extra_amount_invoice_currency,
            depo_relabelling_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_purchase_rate_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_uncategorised_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            base_rate_amount_eur,
            fuel_surcharge_amount_eur,
            toll_surcharge_amount_eur,
            out_of_area_surcharge_amount_eur,
            overweight_or_oversized_amount_eur,
            packaging_or_repacking_amount_eur,
            rerout_and_redeliver_amount_eur,
            relabelling_amount_eur,
            return_fee_amount_eur,
            signature_surcharge_amount_eur,
            illegitimate_amount_eur,
            other_extra_amount_eur,
            depo_relabelling_amount_eur,
            total_purchase_rate_amount_eur,
            total_extra_costs_amount_eur,
            total_illegitimate_amount_eur,
            total_uncategorised_amount_eur,
            total_costs_amount_eur
        from `dv-vgo-fin-prod`.`marts_prep`.`mart_prep_invoice_rows_wide_categories`
        where

            and invoice_id = "3125000589"
    ),

    -- Spec invoices with wide granularity: partially refactored for dupliated and
    -- unmatched
    -- columns
    agg_invoices_with_spec_file as (
        select
            invoice_id,
            invoice_carrier_code,
            invoice_currency,
            min(invoice_date) as invoice_date,
            sum(base_rate_amount_invoice_currency) as base_rate_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                fuel_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as fuel_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                toll_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as toll_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                out_of_area_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as out_of_area_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                overweight_or_oversized_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as overweight_or_oversized_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                packaging_or_repacking_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as packaging_or_repacking_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                rerout_and_redeliver_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as rerout_and_redeliver_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                relabelling_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as relabelling_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                return_fee_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as return_fee_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                signature_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as signature_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                other_extra_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as other_extra_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                depo_relabelling_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as depo_relabelling_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                total_purchase_rate_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as total_purchase_rate_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                total_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as total_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                total_illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as total_illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                total_uncategorised_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as total_uncategorised_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(
                total_costs_amount_invoice_currency
            ) as total_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            sum(total_purchase_rate_amount_eur) as total_purchase_rate_amount_eur,
            sum(base_rate_amount_eur) as base_rate_amount_eur,
            sum(fuel_surcharge_amount_eur) as fuel_surcharge_amount_eur,
            sum(toll_surcharge_amount_eur) as toll_surcharge_amount_eur,
            sum(out_of_area_surcharge_amount_eur) as out_of_area_surcharge_amount_eur,
            sum(
                overweight_or_oversized_amount_eur
            ) as overweight_or_oversized_amount_eur,
            sum(packaging_or_repacking_amount_eur) as packaging_or_repacking_amount_eur,
            sum(rerout_and_redeliver_amount_eur) as rerout_and_redeliver_amount_eur,
            sum(relabelling_amount_eur) as relabelling_amount_eur,
            sum(return_fee_amount_eur) as return_fee_amount_eur,
            sum(signature_surcharge_amount_eur) as signature_surcharge_amount_eur,
            sum(illegitimate_amount_eur) as illegitimate_amount_eur,
            sum(other_extra_amount_eur) as other_extra_amount_eur,
            sum(depo_relabelling_amount_eur) as depo_relabelling_amount_eur,
            sum(total_extra_costs_amount_eur) as total_extra_costs_amount_eur,
            sum(total_illegitimate_amount_eur) as total_illegitimate_amount_eur,
            sum(total_uncategorised_amount_eur) as total_uncategorised_amount_eur,
            sum(total_costs_amount_eur) as total_costs_amount_eur
        from invoices_with_spec_file
        group by all
    ),

    -- we only want to see the most common country code (finance specification)
    get_most_common_country_code_by_invoice_with_spec as (
        select
            invoice_id,
            invoice_carrier_code,
            invoice_currency,
            invoice_from_country_code,
            invoice_to_country_code
        from invoices_with_spec_file
        group by all
        qualify
            row_number() over (
                partition by invoice_id, invoice_carrier_code, invoice_currency
                order by count(*) desc
            )
            = 1
    ),

    join_agg_invoices_with_spec_file_common_country as (
        select
            agg.*,
            most_common_country_code.invoice_from_country_code,
            most_common_country_code.invoice_to_country_code
        from agg_invoices_with_spec_file as agg
        left join
            get_most_common_country_code_by_invoice_with_spec
            as most_common_country_code
            on agg.invoice_id = most_common_country_code.invoice_id
            and agg.invoice_carrier_code = most_common_country_code.invoice_carrier_code
            and agg.invoice_currency = most_common_country_code.invoice_currency
    ),

    /*
        Join With Spec / Not Spec Information together
    */
    join_no_spec_invoices as (
        select
            coalesce(spec.invoice_id, no_spec.invoice_id) as invoice_id,
            coalesce(spec.invoice_date, no_spec.invoice_date) as invoice_date,
            coalesce(
                spec.invoice_carrier_code, no_spec.invoice_carrier_code
            ) as invoice_carrier_code,
            case
                when
                    coalesce(spec.invoice_carrier_code, no_spec.invoice_carrier_code)
                    like "DEPO%"
                then true
                else false
            end as is_depo_relabelling_cost,
            coalesce(
                no_spec.invoice_carrier_code_shipment_level, spec.invoice_carrier_code
            ) as invoice_carrier_code_shipment_level,
            no_spec.adjusted_invoice_carrier_code_shipment_level,

            coalesce(
                spec.invoice_from_country_code, no_spec.invoice_from_country_code
            ) as invoice_from_country_code,
            coalesce(
                spec.invoice_to_country_code, no_spec.invoice_to_country_code
            ) as invoice_to_country_code,

            spec.invoice_carrier_code as spec_invoice_carrier_code,
            no_spec.invoice_carrier_code as no_spec_invoice_carrier_code,
            coalesce(
                spec.invoice_currency, no_spec.invoice_currency
            ) as invoice_currency,

            spec.base_rate_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.fuel_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.toll_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,

            no_spec.no_spec_invoice_amount_invoice_currency,
            no_spec.no_spec_invoice_amount_eur,

            spec.out_of_area_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.overweight_or_oversized_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.packaging_or_repacking_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.rerout_and_redeliver_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.relabelling_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.return_fee_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.signature_surcharge_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.other_extra_amount_invoice_currency,
            spec.depo_relabelling_amount_invoice_currency,

            spec.base_rate_amount_eur,
            spec.fuel_surcharge_amount_eur,
            spec.toll_surcharge_amount_eur,
            spec.out_of_area_surcharge_amount_eur,
            spec.overweight_or_oversized_amount_eur,
            spec.packaging_or_repacking_amount_eur,
            spec.rerout_and_redeliver_amount_eur,
            spec.relabelling_amount_eur,
            spec.return_fee_amount_eur,
            spec.signature_surcharge_amount_eur,
            spec.illegitimate_amount_eur,
            spec.other_extra_amount_eur,
            spec.depo_relabelling_amount_eur,

            no_spec.no_spec_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            no_spec.no_spec_extra_costs_amount_eur,

            coalesce(spec.total_purchase_rate_amount_invoice_currency, 0) + coalesce(
                no_spec.no_spec_invoice_amount_invoice_currency, 0
            ) as total_purchase_rate_amount_invoice_currency,
            coalesce(spec.total_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency, 0) + coalesce(
                no_spec.no_spec_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency, 0
            ) as total_extra_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            total_uncategorised_amount_invoice_currency,
            -- note: to check whether no spec will have illegitimate amounts recorded
            coalesce(
                spec.total_illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency, 0
            ) as total_illegitimate_amount_invoice_currency,
            coalesce(spec.total_costs_amount_invoice_currency, 0) + coalesce(
                no_spec.total_costs_amount_invoice_currency, 0
            ) as total_costs_amount_invoice_currency,
            coalesce(spec.total_purchase_rate_amount_eur, 0) + coalesce(
                no_spec.no_spec_invoice_amount_eur, 0
            ) as total_purchase_rate_amount_eur,
            coalesce(spec.total_extra_costs_amount_eur, 0) + coalesce(
                no_spec.no_spec_extra_costs_amount_eur, 0
            ) as total_extra_costs_amount_eur,

            -- note: to check whether no spec will have illegitimate amounts recorded
            coalesce(
                spec.total_illegitimate_amount_eur, 0
            ) as total_illegitimate_amount_eur,
            spec.total_uncategorised_amount_eur,

            coalesce(spec.total_costs_amount_eur, 0)
            + coalesce(no_spec.total_costs_amount_eur, 0) as total_costs_amount_eur

        from join_agg_invoices_with_spec_file_common_country as spec
        full join
            join_agg_no_spec_invoice_rows as no_spec using (
                invoice_id, invoice_carrier_code
            )
        group by all
    ),

    removed_duplicated_carrier_codes as (
        select * except (spec_invoice_carrier_code, no_spec_invoice_carrier_code)
        from join_no_spec_invoices
        qualify
            row_number() over (
                partition by
                    invoice_id,
                    spec_invoice_carrier_code,
                    total_costs_amount_invoice_currency
                order by
                    case
                        when spec_invoice_carrier_code = no_spec_invoice_carrier_code
                        then 1
                        else 2
                    end,
                    no_spec_invoice_carrier_code,
                    spec_invoice_carrier_code
            )
            = 1
    )

select
    invoice_carrier_code,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_date,
    sum(base_rate_amount_invoice_currency) as sum_non_extra_cost_amount,
    sum(
        total_costs_amount_invoice_currency - base_rate_amount_invoice_currency
    ) as sum_extra_cost_amount,
    sum(total_costs_amount_invoice_currency) as sum_total_amount
from removed_duplicated_carrier_codes
group by all

```

```python
    document_type = carrier_config.get("type", "")
```

comments.body:
tested result with this query:

```sql
with
    cte_model as (
        select

            coalesce(
                shipment_level_origin_country_code, ""
            ) as shipment_level_origin_country_code,

            coalesce(
                shipment_level_destination_country_code, ""
            ) as shipment_level_destination_country_code

        from
            (
                select *
                from
                    `dv-vgo-fin-prod`.`dimensions`.`dim_reporting_route_mapping_by_month`
                where carrier_code_shipment_level = "VINTEDGO-SHOP-FR"
            ) dbt_subquery
    ),
    valid_combinations as (
        select

            case
                split(combination, '|')[safe_offset(0)]
                when 'null'
                then ""
                else split(combination, '|')[safe_offset(0)]
            end as shipment_level_origin_country_code,

            case
                split(combination, '|')[safe_offset(1)]
                when 'null'
                then ""
                else split(combination, '|')[safe_offset(1)]
            end as shipment_level_destination_country_code

        from
            unnest(
                [

                    'null|FR',

                    'BE|BE',

                    'BE|FR',

                    'BE|NL',

                    'DE|FR',

                    'ES|BE',

                    'ES|FR',

                    'ES|NL',

                    'FR|BE',

                    'FR|ES',

                    'FR|FR',

                    'FR|IT',

                    'FR|LU',

                    'FR|NL',

                    'FR|PT',

                    'IE|FR',

                    'IT|BE',

                    'IT|FR',

                    'IT|NL',

                    'LU|BE',

                    'LU|FR',

                    'LU|NL',

                    'NL|BE',

                    'NL|FR',

                    'NL|NL',

                    'PT|BE',

                    'PT|FR',

                    'PT|NL'

                ]
            ) as combination
    )

select

    cte_model.shipment_level_origin_country_code,
    cte_model.shipment_level_destination_country_code,
    count(*) as combination_count
from cte_model
left join
    valid_combinations
    on cte_model.shipment_level_origin_country_code
    = valid_combinations.shipment_level_origin_country_code
    and

    cte_model.shipment_level_destination_country_code
    = valid_combinations.shipment_level_destination_country_code

where

    valid_combinations.shipment_level_origin_country_code is null or

    valid_combinations.shipment_level_destination_country_code is null

group by

    cte_model.shipment_level_origin_country_code,

    cte_model.shipment_level_destination_country_code

having count(*) > 0

```

prs.title: chore: alter reporting carrier in the `dim_prep_existing_shipping_routes_frequency` for homerr changes
prs.description:
* follow up from https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-dbt/pull/3964.
* this changes the `reporting_carrier` to updated names, which allows for a join
* the backfill is changed in this [google colab](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1xUYM06D5j_FEcR3Je_whESy-4r9BRymH#scrollTo=iFe7AYnYuBkE):

```python
import pandas as pd
from google.cloud import storage
from google.colab import auth
import io

auth.authenticate_user()
gcs_path = 'gs://dv-vgo-fin-prod-datasets/existing_shipping_routes_frequency/existing_shipping_routes_frequency_backfill.parquet'
client = storage.Client()
df = pd.read_parquet(gcs_path, storage_options={'token': 'cloud'})

to_replace_df = df.copy()

def replace_value(carrier):
        if carrier == 'HOMERR':
            return 'VINTED GO BNL'
        elif carrier == 'PRO CARRIER':
            return 'ANPOST-MONDIAL'
        elif carrier == 'RELAIS-HOMERR':
            return 'RELAIS-VINTED GO BNL'
        elif carrier == 'VINTED GO-HOMERR':
            return 'VINTED GO-VINTED GO BNL'
        else:
            return carrier

to_replace_df['reporting_carrier'] =  to_replace_df['reporting_carrier'].apply(replace_value)

# Save the DataFrame back to GCS using a buffer
bucket_name = gcs_path.split('/')[2]
blob_path = '/'.join(gcs_path.split('/')[3:])
bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
blob = bucket.blob(blob_path)

buffer = io.BytesIO()
to_replace_df.to_parquet(buffer, index=False)
buffer.seek(0)  # Reset buffer position to the beginning

blob.upload_from_file(buffer)

print(f"DataFrame saved to {gcs_path}")
```

* according to guste, there are two types of files in retrieved compensations: service now (SN) and lost parcels (UCP).

prs.title: feat: remap VINTEDGO-SHOP-FR to reporting carriers which have information on VINTEDGO BNL
prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ * see context: [slack thread](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/G01PZBW4Q9Y/p1738912044730349) * in this PR, the following proposal is implemented: > * only when "carrier code shipment level" is VINTEDGO-SHOP-FR, we will look at the route to determine whether to map it to "VINTEDGO-VINTEDGO BNL", or "VINTEDGO". > * this will only be reflected in the "reporting carrier". there will be no change to the "carrier code shipment level". the reason for this is that we take the "carrier code shipment level" as a representation of what comes from the backend, and that i propose we do not deviate from this with custom logic so that we will be able to debug errors more easily going forward. from this, we see that it's only FR<>BE and FR<>NL routes which need to be remapped. they will be indicated with a different `reporting_route_matching_method`: `1a. manual override for vintedgo-bnl direct injection routes` ```sql select distinct carrier_code_shipment_level, shipment_level_origin_country_code, shipment_level_destination_country_code, reporting_carrier from `dimensions.dim_reporting_route_mapping_by_month` where lower(carrier_code_shipment_level) like '%vintedgo-shop-fr%' and lower(carrier_code_shipment_level) like '%homerr%' and reporting_route_matching_method like '1.%' order by 2, 3 ``` there are also some former HOMERR routes which should be remapped: ```sql select distinct carrier_code_shipment_level, shipment_level_origin_country_code, shipment_level_destination_country_code, reporting_carrier from `dimensions.dim_reporting_route_mapping_by_month` where ( ( shipment_level_origin_country_code = 'BE' and shipment_level_destination_country_code = 'NL' ) or ( shipment_level_origin_country_code = 'BE' and shipment_level_destination_country_code = 'BE' ) or ( shipment_level_origin_country_code = 'NL' and shipment_level_destination_country_code = 'NL' ) or ( shipment_level_origin_country_code = 'NL' and shipment_level_destination_country_code = 'BE' ) ) and carrier_code_shipment_level like any ('%HOMERR%', '%VINTEDGO-BNL%') and reporting_route_matching_method like '1.%' order by 2, 3 ``` there continues to be other routes for `VINTEDGO-SHOP-FR`. they will still be mapped by the mapping solution to the most likely routes if the routes do not exist, and they will not be overwritten. ```sql select distinct carrier_code_shipment_level, shipment_level_origin_country_code, shipment_level_destination_country_code from `dimensions.dim_reporting_route_mapping_by_month` where lower(carrier_code_shipment_level) like 'vintedgo-shop-fr' ``` # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ # Checklist prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* when reviewing weight categories from invoices, we saw that the purported weights were 14, 32, 35, etc. (with a unit of measurement of kg). this seemed not reasonable. ([looker](https://looker.vinted.net/explore/vgo_finance/invoice_rows?toggle=fil&qid=UVhcI8vkiA09RGDOGme6yn))
 
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c276efe3-99f8-4834-a592-e81bd4b1c082)

* as USPS is a US carrier, we expect that the weights are either in `lbs` or `oz`. 
* asked GPT, learnt that it's more reasonably `oz`.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c6b82a1-efa9-4f82-8c5c-ae04b3648819)

* this PR adjusts the weights to `kg` from `oz` by including a multiplication factor.

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

the downstream lens will allow users to see which domains their changes will affect. together with this, they'll be informed who and where (which channel) they should alert others about the changes. [this is more context](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C0551NF0N80/p1741354255110149?thread_ts=1741352174.214069&cid=C0551NF0N80). a sample alert looks like this:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/763eb7d8-0a2c-48c9-ab21-a342ae6a9ba7)

the attribute, `consumer_channel`, will determine which channel is listed in the alert. otherwise, the default will be the `channel` (which should be more for alerts).

this PR sets the consumer channel for respective domains.

prs.title: feat: process irregular column names
prs.description:
there are cases where we want to test for `null`s on `coalesce(...)` of columns, for example:

```yml
    gs://dv-vgo-fin-prod-csv-cleaner-output-bucket/depo/logic_v1/:
        invoice_carrier_code: DEPO
        finops_owner:
            - jeremy.chia # change when done
        dbt_staging_models:
            name: stg_carrier_invoices__depo
            columns:
                - name: coalesce(invoice_barcode, invoice_external_code, invoice_tracking_code)
                  depends_on:
                      - outbound_carrier_code
                      - outbound_label
                      - inbound_label
```

in this case, the column name is `coalesce(invoice_barcode, invoice_external_code, invoice_tracking_code)` because we want to test if the fields (all of them considered) are still null.

without any amendment, this would cause a compilation error in SQL:
```python
[f'countif({column} is null) as null_{column}' for column in column_names_to_check]
```

as it will become
```sql
countif(coalesce(invoice_barcode, invoice_external_code, invoice_tracking_code) is null) as null_coalesce(invoice_barcode, invoice_external_code, invoice_tracking_code)
```

converting this to snake case resolves such situations.
prs.author: jeremychia

prs.title: fix: command reference in scheduler for vgo_finance
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

# easypost
* previously, run was at 21h UTC, and would query for 1 day before. (i.e. on 2025-03-09, it would download data for 2025-03-08).
* currently, that run happens at 1h UTC, it tries to download for 1 day before, but the data is not available yet.
* to adjust such that it downloads for 2 days before (i.e. on 2025-03-10 1h UTC, it downloads 2025-03-08).

# royal mail
* suspect the shell is interpreting escaped quotes before the python script receives the arguments.
* this results in the following error (that only the part before the space gets parsed:
> main.py: error: argument --start_timestamp: Invalid timestamp format for '"2025-03-10'. Expected format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS+00:00'
* to adjust the quoting marks in attempt to correct the parsing.

prs.title: feat: adjust ups invoice date calculation logic
prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ * there was shipment join failure for one of the UPS invoices. this was because of the invoice date matching logic. * this PR changes the calculated invoice date to the last day of the latest label received. * in particular, the invoice id which triggered the alert was 202410801089, and it saw a match percentage improvement from 76.8% to 99.76%. checks: _the new logic was loaded into `dv-vgo-fin-sb.staging.stg_carrier_invoices__ups`_ * with the new logic, only 95 invoices (out of 1,150 invoices) have seen a change in the invoice date. * in all 95 cases, the invoice date has shifted later; i.e. none of the new dates were earlier. | effect | count | |-|-| | improved matching | 12 | | no effect | 83 | | worse matching | 0 | (see [google sheets](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LZii0VFV2_QHPJ39GoTjwyuFjdGiNP6MZk5RLO8OuXM/edit?gid=1798518686#gid=1798518686)) ```sql with new_logic as ( select distinct invoice_id, invoice_date as new_invoice_date from `dv-vgo-fin-sb.staging.stg_carrier_invoices__ups` ), old_logic as ( select distinct invoice_id, invoice_date as old_invoice_date from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.staging.stg_carrier_invoices__ups` ), check_changes as ( select *, new_invoice_date != old_invoice_date as has_invoice_date_changed from new_logic full join old_logic using (invoice_id) ) select count(*), countif(has_invoice_date_changed) from check_changes where new_invoice_date < old_invoice_date ``` # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ # Checklist _Fill out only the sections applicable to the PR. prs.title: fix: investigate and resolve duplicate shipment carrier leg ids causing database errors
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* failure in pipeline due to `mart_prep_shipment_legs_tracking_statuses_finance` being unable to build:
```sh
Database Error in model mart_prep_shipment_legs_tracking_statuses_finance
UPDATE/MERGE must match at most one source row for each target row
```

* found there were duplicates in both the source (original table) and target table (table to merge from incremental run) ([slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C0838MUEFFC/p1737700882618789?thread_ts=1737695059.628709&cid=C0838MUEFFC)).
* there were some from shipments created on 2025-01-22 and 2025-01-23, where the shipment_carrier_leg_id appeared in 2 of the 3 - cancelled, failed, and/or processed shipments.

this PR therefore:
* does a deduplication on the outputs CTE `union_carrier_legs` to remove the deduplicates.
* does a one-off deduplication (as a full refresh would also still result in duplicates) on the existing dataset in the `prod`.

prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. prs.title: fix: transaction_id is ambiguous (retain original logic in BQInvoices)
prs.description:
* there was an ambiguous reference to `transaction_id` which caused this model to fail ([hue logs](https://hue.ams1.int.vinted.com/hue/jobbrowser/#!id=application_1736454498437_46623)). 

> Stdoutput Exception in thread "main" org.apache.spark.sql.AnalysisException: [AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE] Reference `transaction_id` is ambiguous, could be: [`invoices`.`transaction_id`, `spark_catalog`.`double_entry`.`vship_shipping_labels`.`transaction_id`].

* this was because `transaction_id` was exposed to `fct_invoice_rows` in https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-dbt/pull/3400
* to keep the original logic of `BQInvoices`, to drop `transaction_id` from the original table.

prs.description:
* boolean fields were being casted to strings, which caused a mismatch in types when attempting to filter, as reported by @divyadev-vinted in [slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C24DPMS0L/p1736873673434889).

> 
invalidQuery: No matching signature for operator = for argument types: BOOL, STRING Signature: T1 = T1 Unable to find common supertype for templated argument <T1> Input types for <T1>: {BOOL, STRING} at [4:7]

## to-do

* check with #buyer-analytics-engineering if there is a reason to continue using this as custom content - as the lookml generator should be able to generate the booleans.

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]

* previous logic assumed a 1:1 cardinality between transfers and settlements.
* yesterday, there was a failure in transfer (showed status 'failed') because of insufficient funds ([slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C029AJJ0MC0/p1736842978818079))
* adds tests and filters to handle failed transfers, which should be excluded from the reporting

this was picked up by a uniqueness test which threw a [warning](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C041KP1LXGS/p1736916174566209) this morning:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ecf9d2b8-931b-45c4-aa02-7a11ce2ec2ff)
```sql
select *
from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.staging.stg_cdc__svc_dhl_de_integration_transfers`
where
    settlement_id in (
        select settlement_id
        from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.staging.stg_cdc__svc_dhl_de_integration_transfers`
        group by all
        having count(*) > 1
    )

```

prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ * issue arose because of missing `relabelling_invoice_carrier_code`, which caused issues with reporting. * when checking staging model, found the reason was because the `inbound_invoice_carrier_code` was null for some invoice rows due to new patterns in the `inbound_label`, and therefore, it was not mapped: * checked new patterns and cross-referenced against `dim_prep_shipment_carrier_legs_joining_keys` for tracking code patterns (thanks @jsakalyte for the hint), and deduced 4 new patterns (`EB77%`, `EB78%`, `EM000%`, `5221070%`). this catches most cases, leaving 3 which are unmapped. suggest to leave these 3. query used for cross-referencing: ```sql with cleaned as ( select distinct inbound_label, outbound_direction, regexp_replace( split(outbound_direction, '-')[safe_offset(0)], '_', '-' ) as outbound_carrier_code from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.carrier_invoices.depo` ), cleaned_with_invoice_carrier_codes as ( select *, case when length(inbound_label) = 10 then "BOXNOW-HR" when length(inbound_label) = 13 and (inbound_label like "NR0%" or inbound_label like "NB0%") then "CZECH-POST-SHOP-CZ" when length(inbound_label) = 13 and ( inbound_label like "210%" or inbound_label like "260%" or inbound_label like "262%" ) then "ORLEN-SHOP-PL" when inbound_label like "703%" then "SPS-SHOP-SK" when inbound_label like "CLF%" then "FOXPOST-LOCKER-HU" when inbound_label like "603%" or inbound_label like "520%" then "SLOVAK-POST-SK" end as inbound_carrier_code, case when outbound_carrier_code = 'BOX-NOW' then 'BOXNOW-HR' when outbound_carrier_code = 'CZECH-POST' then 'CZECH-POST-SHOP-CZ' when outbound_carrier_code = 'IN-POST' then 'INPOST-LOCKER-PL' when outbound_carrier_code = 'ORLEN' then 'ORLEN-SHOP-PL' when outbound_carrier_code = 'SLOVAK-POST' then 'SLOVAK-POST-SK' when outbound_carrier_code = 'SPS' then 'SPS-SHOP-SK' when outbound_carrier_code = 'FOXPOST' then 'FOXPOST-LOCKER-HU' when outbound_carrier_code = 'PPL' then 'PPL-SMART-CZ' else outbound_carrier_code end as outbound_carrier_code_cleaned, from cleaned ), renamed as ( select *, concat( inbound_carrier_code, ', ', outbound_carrier_code_cleaned ) as relabelling_invoice_carrier_code from cleaned_with_invoice_carrier_codes ) select * from renamed where inbound_carrier_code is null and inbound_label not like 'EB78%' and inbound_label not like 'EB77%' and inbound_label not like '5221070%' and inbound_label not like 'EM000%' ``` # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or prs.title: fix: deduplication for time tracking users
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* `dim_employees` build failed as there were non-unique values. 
* this originated from the join below, as other dependent models have unique tests or deduplications which pass.
```sql
left join
    {{ ref("stg_lake_hub_time_tracking__users") }} as time_tracking_users
    on time_tracking_users.verification_hub_employee_id = fulfilment_users.user_id
```
* identified issue to be with `id=29`. see [slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C041KP1LXGS/p1736747574948179?thread_ts=1736728172.701999&cid=C041KP1LXGS). issue can be seen with:
```sql
select *
from `dv-vgo-hvf-prod.staging.stg_lake_hub_time_tracking__users`
where
    verification_hub_employee_id in (
        select verification_hub_employee_id
        from `dv-vgo-hvf-prod.staging.stg_lake_hub_time_tracking__users`
        group by all
        having count(*) > 1
    )
```
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/32461412-d742-4eb3-8e54-cb9b3087fe62)


this PR:
* deduplicates by user's ID in `stg_lake_hub_time_tracking__users`.

prs.title: chore: retail invoice deduplication removal
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* retail invoices were deduplicated based on reference, because of a backend issue with deduplicate invoice headers.
* they have since been fixed. see [slack thread](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C048N42SLSU/p1736507339288149?thread_ts=1712920438.618389&cid=C048N42SLSU).
* this only yields RCs which are duplicated, no more RIs (expectation is one RI invoice per reference).

```sql
with
    deduplicate_id as (
        select *
        from `dv-vgo-d2c-prod.cdc.svc_shipping_retail_invoices`
        qualify row_number() over (partition by id order by __kafka_offset desc) = 1
    )

select *
from deduplicate_id
where __deleted = false
qualify count(id) over (partition by reference, invoice_series) > 1
order by reference, created_at desc

```

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* originating from @jsakalyte's comment: https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-dbt/pull/3186#discussion_r1899534998
* this PR introduces a test for accepted values for delivery type codes, for completeness, such that they can be mapped to a service type.
* tests for a 30 day window because that's the partitioning replacement window for `shipment_created_at`:
```sql
{% set partitions_to_replace = shared.get_partitions_to_replace(
    data_interval_start=var("data_interval_start"),
    periods_to_replace=30,
    time_granularity="day",
) %}

{{
    config(
        materialized="incremental",
        incremental_strategy="insert_overwrite",
        partition_by={
            "field": "shipment_created_at",
            "data_type": "date",
            "granularity": "day",
        },
        partitions=partitions_to_replace,
    )
}}
```

prs.title: chore: adjust waiting time between tasks
prs.description:
* ~as report URLs expire in 30 seconds, changes retry interval to 10 seconds, to have a better possibility of retrieving the report when it is available.~ mimics previous setting for retry intervals:
```python
        wait_for_report_to_be_ready = PythonSensor(
            task_id=f"{report_type}__wait_for_report_ready",
            python_callable=is_report_ready,
            mode="reschedule",
            op_args=[report_type],
            poke_interval=10 * 60,
            timeout=3 * 60 * 60,
        )
```
* also adds a time interval between successive runs.
prs.author: jeremychia

_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* #2826 created mapping table `dim_reporting_route_mapping_by_month`
* unfortunately, there are some marketplace shipping routes which were missing. see [google sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ldNhtNRWbigAVuELLnMIveLYrwZOWeDy9nltgn3xL_c/edit?gid=1428666399#gid=1428666399).
* this PR makes mapping possible from 'customer_invoice_month >= 2024-01-01' for missing marketplace carriers.
* currently implemented as a seed, which takes data from this query:

```sql
with
    missing as (
        select transaction_id
        from `dv-grf-fin-prod.marts.mrt_shipping_revenue_vs_costs`
        where
            reporting_carrier is null
            and shipment_carrier_leg_id is null
            and date_trunc(revenue_cost_date, year) = "2024-01-01"
    ),
    transaction_data as (
        select
            prep_transactions.transaction_id,
            buyer_country_code,
            seller_country_code,
            carrier
        from `dv-grf-fin-prod.preparation.prep_transactions` as prep_transactions
        inner join missing on missing.transaction_id = prep_transactions.transaction_id
    )
select buyer_country_code, seller_country_code, carrier
from transaction_data
group by all
order by 1, 2, 3

```

prs.title: feat: new condition for expected costs for self-billing where revenue recognition is `null`
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

context:

* elimination of self-billing (where carrier_id is 97 (VINTEDGO-FR-SHOP) for the first mile and last mile) is currently dependent on `revenue_recognition_date`. because it was 0.2 EUR in 2023 and before, and 0 from 2024 and onwards.
* there are some D2C cases spotted ([jira comment](https://vinted.atlassian.net/browse/VGOFIN-717?focusedCommentId=991269)) where there self-billing cases.
* on investigation, the reason why there are values is because they are missing `revenue_recognition_date`s.

this PR:

* uses `shipment_created_at` as a proxy as a cut-off to see that the expected costs for these self-billing cases are zeroised.

see this logic to confirm that the expected costs are reduced to zero:
```sql
select
    shipment_carrier_leg_id,
    carrier_id_first_mile_backend,
    carrier_id_last_mile_backend,
    revenue_recognition_date,
    is_first_leg_multi_leg_shipment,
    is_second_leg_multi_leg_shipment,
    purchase_rate_excl_vat_eur_backend_weight,
    expected_carrier_cost_eur_backend_weight,
    shipment_created_at,
    -- new logic
    case
        when
            revenue_recognition_date is null
            and carrier_id_first_mile_backend = 97
            and carrier_id_last_mile_backend = 97
            -- from 2024 and onwards, there will be no more self-billing costs.
            -- this case addresses cases where is no revenue recognition date, and
            -- uses shipment_created_at as a proxy
            and shipment_created_at >= '2024-01-01'
        then 0
        else purchase_rate_excl_vat_eur_backend_weight
    end as new_expected_carrier_cost_eur_backend_weight
from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.marts.mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue`
where
    shipment_carrier_leg_id in (
        select shipment_carrier_leg_id
        from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.marts.mart_d2c_invoice_cost_and_revenue`
        where
            revenue_recognition_date < "2025-01-01"
            and revenue_recognition_date >= "2024-01-01"
            and carrier_id_first_mile_backend = 97
            and carrier_id_last_mile_backend = 97
            and shipment_level_origin_country_code = 'FR'
            and shipment_level_destination_country_code = 'FR'
            and purchase_price_carrier_price_list_eur
            = expected_carrier_cost_eur_backend_weight
    )

```


# To do list
_If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._

* it appears the d2c table has a different way of determining the revenue recognition date:
```sql
case
    -- take invoice_date + 14 days when we have no delivery date and the order wasn't
    -- refunded
    when
        mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue_d2c.delivered_event_arrival_time
        is null
        and current_date()
        >= date(date_add(retail_orders_convert_eur.invoice_date, interval 14 day))
        and retail_payment_status != 'refunded'
    then date(date_add(retail_orders_convert_eur.invoice_date, interval 14 day))
    -- don't use delivery date more than 14 days after the invoice_date so the report
    -- doesn't change over time
    when
        mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue_d2c.delivered_event_arrival_time
        > date(date_add(retail_orders_convert_eur.invoice_date, interval 14 day))
    then date(date_add(retail_orders_convert_eur.invoice_date, interval 14 day))
    -- use the delivery date when it's within 14 days of the invoice_date
    else mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue_d2c.delivered_event_arrival_time
end as revenue_recognition_date,
```

* to add to the backlog to standardise this.

`vgo_d2c` had built without issue today, but the `vgo_finance` DAG, which has a dependency on a table in `vgo_d2c`, failed because a dependency not being 'fresh':
```
vgo_d2c__facts.fact_retail_payouts is not fresh
```

current lookback window for freshness is 7 days. to change to 14 days to allow for DAG to build.

prs.title: fix: carrier codes logic in DoubleEntryShippingRevenue
prs.description:
* previously, the logic for populating `origin`, which is exposed as "Carriers" in looker, is only such that there are values when there is the same first and last mile carrier.

```scala
.withColumn("carriers_code",
        when($"first_mile_carriers_code" === $"last_mile_carriers_code", $"first_mile_carriers_code"))
```

* since there are multi-leg shipments now, this would not be feasible to keep the logic as such.
* to take the logic in ShipmentDimension to populate this field. this PR changes that:

```scala
      .withColumn("carrier",
        when($"is_direct_injection", concat_ws(" -> ", $"first_mile_carrier", $"last_mile_carrier"))
        .when($"first_mile_carrier_id" === $"last_mile_carrier_id", $"first_mile_carrier")
         .otherwise($"primary_carrier"))
```

in this case, the logic is slightly amended to switch the order of the is_direct_injection condition and first=last mile ID.

there are some edits to the name to adapt to the joins made in `DoubleEntryShippingRevenue`, but the results are expected to be the same.

there are 146 combinations which will now have values, see in hue:
```sql
with aggregated as (
select
    first_mile_carriers_code,
    last_mile_carriers_code,
    primary_carriers_code,
    carriers_code,
    carriers_code_new
from dev_jeremy_chia.double_entry_shipping_revenue_carrier_code
group by
    first_mile_carriers_code,
    last_mile_carriers_code,
    primary_carriers_code,
    carriers_code,
    carriers_code_new
)

select *
from aggregated
```

majority of the cases should see the `origin` field populated.

prs.title: feat: add hvf leg information to mart shipment legs invoice cost and revenue
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

from request:

> Some time ago, you set up this query (copied in the thread) for HVF IVS returns. However, using BigQuery instead of Looker is not as convenient. Could you set up this data in a Looker view, similar to the look I shared above?

this PR:

* adds the missing columns, which are `is_provisioned_hvf_return_leg` and `is_used_hvf_return_leg`.

the query:

```sql
with
    authentication_failures as (
        select
            carrier_leg_id,
            shipment_id,
            transaction_id,
            carrier_leg_created_at,
            is_provisioned_hvf_return_leg,
            is_used_hvf_return_leg,
            country_code_origin,
        from `dv-vgo-gen-prod.facts.fct_processed_carrier_legs` leg
        left join
            `dv-vgo-gen-prod.dimensions.dim_shipment_configuration` dim
            on leg.parcel_configuration_key = dim.parcel_configuration_key
        where
            leg.carrier_leg_created_at >= '2024-01-01' #need a earlier date, as invoices might be coming later
            and has_item_verification = true
            and is_used_hvf_return_leg = true 
        order by shipment_id, carrier_leg_created_at
    ),

    shipment_legs_cost_and_revenue as (
        select
            carrier_code,
            FORMAT_DATE('%Y %m', revenue_recognition_date) AS invoice_date,
            shipment_carrier_leg_id,
            shipment_created_at,
            -- shipped_event_arrival_time,
            -- shipped_date,
            total_costs_amount_eur,
            expected_carrier_cost_eur_backend_weight,
        from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.marts.mart_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue`
        where shipment_created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    )

select *
from authentication_failures
inner join
    shipment_legs_cost_and_revenue
    on authentication_failures.carrier_leg_id
    = shipment_legs_cost_and_revenue.shipment_carrier_leg_id
order by shipment_id, carrier_leg_id
;
```

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* relates to #3009
* there were missing commas. logic is updated in the [google colab](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1qPmpy2W5yifIGFEB96VGRVTvx0dccc9B#scrollTo=YkodPfc_yZtE).

```python
sql_for_models = """
{% set schemas_and_models = {
"""

for schema, model in models.items():

  model_list_to_str = "'" + "', '".join(models[schema]) + "'"

  sql_for_models += f"""
  \"{schema}\": \"{model_list_to_str}\",
"""
  

sql_for_models += """
} %}

with unioned as (
    {% for schema_name, models in schemas_and_models.items() %}
        (
            {{
                get_model_metadata(
                    project_id=target.project,
                    schema_name=schema_name,
                    models_list=models,
                )
            }}
        )
        {% if not loop.last %}union all{% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
)
select *
from unioned
"""
```

prs.title: feat: download reports from 15+30 days ago (royal mail)
prs.description:
follow up from #21.
adds DAGs which will download reports from 15, 30 days ago.

why?

* in order to reconcile the reconciliation reports from royal mail's APIs with the invoice issued, we need to account for:
   * billings, which are available by transaction date.
   * less the spoilage amounts, which are only available by spoilage date.

* the reconciliation report only allows us to download the information by transaction date. i.e. in this example:

|transactionDate|spoilageOn|remarks|
|-|-|-|
|2024-10-21|2024-11-19|if we download it on 2024-10-22 (one day after), we will only see that we were invoiced for it. but in this case, we were not to be invoiced for it because there is a spoilage. we will only know this if we download the transactions dated 2024-10-21 on 2024-11-20 (one day after the spoilage).  so that means we need to download the information again).
|2024-10-22| |this will be downloaded on 2024-10-23 (one day after), and because there is no spoilage, there is no problem.|

therefore, for the completeness of data, we need to download the information again. while checking the source data, we observed that the max difference is 24 days. but for reporting purposes, we decided to take the following schedules:

* 1 days after: to know the initial amounts
* 15 days after: for reporting purposes, to get an amount which is close to the invoice amount ([#nasa feedback](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/CUKQK8MJ9/p1732199187032229?thread_ts=1731945202.449829&cid=CUKQK8MJ9): should only expect only a max of 11 business days will lapse from the transaction date can the shipment be cancelled (spoiled), i.e. most spoilages should occur within 15 days).
* 30 days after: for completeness, to reconcile the amounts
prs.author: jeremychia

prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ this PR attempts to replace the logic which is being done by this [google apps script](https://script.google.com/u/0/home/projects/1bQAApKz8soG2nF9zdRG1x1qY_kYLUyBDI2q0A3cm2dAnaH3yRdkQsKRY/edit), with refactoring to remove redundant transformations. this pertains to [this conversation](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C06105W2T6F/p1723637659226329?thread_ts=1723630794.399919&cid=C06105W2T6F). in doing so, the following is done: * archived old data sources as a parquet file ([google colab notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1EW4UJQQVgzgVnhQS8oQ7wSslZrL3sZD1)) * stage external source to the google sheet: [NEW Shipping Invoice Review 2024](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TUdJ4kRTZy70jfK7RyRkvSYUK_hfqNFqhlrI-MVagBw/edit?gid=1124400910#gid=1124400910) * replace sources for `fct_no_spec_file_invoice_rows`. notes: [1] this is the original logic for mapping the `document_issued_by` name to the carrier names: > =IFERROR(IF(OR(D${row}="Delamode DI",D${row}="DSV DI",D${row}="DSV DI Lockers",D${row}="Delamode Domestic",D${row}="Delamode DI Lockers",D${row}="Delamode DI>Omniva",D${row}="LINK DI VCarrier"),VLOOKUP(D${row}&">"&P${row}&">"&Q${row},MAPPING!J:K,2,0),VLOOKUP(D${row},MAPPING!D:E,2,0)),"") this will no longer be followed, as a check shows that for the new files, there are no entities with the names in the "OR" condition. ```sql select distinct document_issued_by from ( select distinct document_issued_by from `dev_jeremy_chia.stg_google_sheets__invoice_review_no_details` union all select distinct document_issued_by from `dev_jeremy_chia.stg_google_sheets__invoice_review_main` ) where document_issued_by in ( 'Delamode DI', 'DSV DI', 'DSV DI Lockers', 'Delamode Domestic', 'Delamode DI Lockers', 'Delamode DI>Omniva', 'LINK DI VCarrier' ) order by 1 ; ``` a further check on the results also show that for new files, there is no remapping that is being done. see the check in [these google sheets](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10eFYdFJGMWW_R78CclKWFjEiDMKfBtBSNXpWS1ldDgI/edit?gid=1804391732#gid=1804391732). [2] there is data parity, with the exception of this invoice id `9071783854`: ```sql with dev as ( select _row_source, invoice_id, sum(no_spec_invoice_amount_invoice_currency) as dev_amt from `dv-vgo-fin-sb.dev_jeremy_chia.fct_no_spec_file_invoice_rows` group by all ), prod as ( select invoice_id, sum(no_spec_invoice_amount_invoice_currency) as prod_amt from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.facts.fct_no_spec_file_invoice_rows` group by all ) select *, dev_amt != prod_amt from prod full join dev using (invoice_id) where dev_amt != prod_amt ``` see this [linked comment](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TUdJ4kRTZy70jfK7RyRkvSYUK_hfqNFqhlrI-MVagBw/edit?disco=AAABY9mq0hM) about the invoice. # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ # Checklist _Fill out only the sections applicable to the PR. prs.title: fix: is d2c compensation flag should be no for cases where the net effect is 0
prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ * fixes cases where payout was flagged as a compensation but was not, because the payout was cancelled. * these cases can be identified by way of looking at the net amount of `processing_currency_amount`. if these were zero, they should not be flagged as a compensation. in addition, the condition for not tagging references which are reconciliations (e.g. `%00000%`) arre adjusted, to exclude more references which awere erroneously included because of too many zeroes. checked the differences, and these are the rows with a difference: (see cases where reference was not containing 000000 - these refer to other reports. the adjustments here are only for references where the net amount are 0. the flag changes only for lines which was previously flagged as zero). ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62f34877-289a-4f6d-b59e-c99a12fa0d8d) ```sql with details as ( select reference, is_d2c_compensation_payout, breakdown_type in ('Card Payout', 'Payout') and reference not like '%000000%' -- in this case, the payout corresponds to the retail_payout_uuid and reference is not null and (processing_currency_amount < 0 or holding_currency_amount < 0) -- there are some cases where the action shows a 0 amount, in this case, it's likely that it was declined and sum(processing_currency_amount) over (partition by reference) != 0 -- in the case where the payout was cancelled, the nett amount is 0, and these are not compensation payouts as revised_flag_is_d2c_compensation_payout, processing_currency_amount from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.facts.fct_checkout_financial_actions_reports` ) select * from details where revised_flag_is_d2c_compensation_payout != is_d2c_compensation_payout; ``` cross-referenced with references which were zero. these correspond to the changes above: ```sql select reference, round(sum(processing_currency_amount), 2), round( sum( case when lower(breakdown_type) like '%payout%' then processing_currency_amount end ), 2 ), count(*) from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.facts.fct_checkout_financial_actions_reports` where reference in ( select distinct reference from `dv-vgo-fin-prod.facts.fct_checkout_financial_actions_reports` where is_d2c_compensation_payout = true ) group by all having round(sum(processing_currency_amount), 2) = 0 ``` # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ # Checklist _Fill out only the sections applicable to the PR. > Ok so the problem is that vunit and dv-checkpoint use different versions of pydantic and there are breaking changes in these versions, meaning that it's not easy to update.
> Hence to solve, i would recommend to remove dv-checkpoint from your local environment. If you are using it locally, you can install it through pipx
* this is removed in the marketplace here: https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-marketplace-dbt/pull/4226
> Removes dv-checkpoint from local env since it causes conflicts with vunit. 
>
> If people want to use `dv-checkpoint` locally, they should install it through pipx: 
>```
>pipx install git+https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-checkpoint.git     
>```

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, RFCs, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

fixes [schema mismatch](https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-looker/actions/runs/11513282659/job/32051000172?pr=942):
```shell
Schema Mismatch for model mart_historic_carrier_contract_prices!!
            BigQuery refers to the model generated from running the dbt model (i.e. the SQL file.)
            dbt (or dbt Manifest) here refers to the columns named in the YAML file.
            There seems to be a mismatch between the schemas for these (BigQuery and dbt)
            Columns found in BigQuery not present in dbt:  customer_name
            Columns present in DBT not found in BigQuery: is_rate_for_vinted_marketplace_customer
            Please check for spelling variations.
            All columns generated by the SQL code must also be present in the YAML file.
```

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

fixes failing test, because of a required partition filter:
```shell
[2024-10-25, 01:39:56 UTC] {pod_manager.py:435} INFO - [base] ^[[0m01:39:56    Database Error in test unique_prep_member_lifecycle_milestone_dates_user_id (models/preparation/_preparation__models.yml)
[2024-10-25, 01:39:56 UTC] {pod_manager.py:435} INFO - [base]   Cannot query over table 'dv-mkp-mtch-prod.staging.stg_events__user_upload_item_start' without a filter over column(s) 'upload_item_page_view_at' that can be used for partition elimination
[2024-10-25, 01:39:56 UTC] {pod_manager.py:435} INFO - [base]   compiled code at target/run/member_lifecycle/models/preparation/_preparation__models.yml/unique_prep_member_lifecycle_milestone_dates_user_id.sql
```

because the model `prep_member_lifecycle_milestone_dates`:
* calls on `fct_upload_item_page_views`, a view
* which queries `stg_events__user_upload_item_start`, where a required partition filter is enforced

something to look out for:
* whether the other tables with partitions will start using `required_partition_filter`. (e.g. `{{ ref_other_data_space("trust__dimensions", "dim_users") }}`))

prs.title: feat: copy table mart historic carrier contract prices and expose information to looker
prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

this PR does three things:

* `union all` for `mart_historic_carrier_contract_prices`, which will be moved from `marts_snapshot` to `marts`.
   * backfilling of `carrier_contract_price_id`, which was not available previously.
   * the `marts_snapshot` will be dropped in the same query.
* introduction of `price_list_exact_join_excl_date_key`, which is an MD5 hash of all the exact match join keys for the price list, less validity dates. this is helpful for comparing changes in the validity dates.
* expose the table (`marts`) to looker.

why?

* historical comparisons of price lists will be enabled in a dashboard.
* these are the preparation steps to help with dashboarding.

this has been tested and created as: `dv-vgo-fin-sb.marts.mart_historic_carrier_contract_prices`
```sql
select *
from `dv-vgo-fin-sb.marts.mart_historic_carrier_contract_prices`
where _snapshot_at < "2024-10-24"
order by price_list_carrier_key, _snapshot_at
limit 1000
```

note that 2024-10-22 is from the `marts`, and 2024-10-01 and before is from `marts_snapshot`.

prs.title: feat: test for non-null carrier codes in carrier_legs_prep
prs.description: # Summary [Required] _What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._ * previously, VGo Finance Data Control detected that there were `carrier_code`s which were `null`. this affected the ability to report these shipments as part of a carrier code. ([slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C070XCLHARL/p1729614841384939)) * to ensure that `carrier_code`s are present, to add a test here to assert the the `carrier_code` is not null. * the test is limited to the last 7 days of `carrier_leg_created_at` for prudence. not necessary to run the test on the whole table as it is presumed that once created, the configuration keys do not change. something to consider: * it is not intended for this test failure to cause the entire DAG to fail. * therefore, my question is if we want to create another DAG task to perform data tests like these, which are meant to get assurance on the quality of data but yet should not cause the DAG to fail. note also, i have checked against the last 30 days and do not see any non-joins, and therefore this test will not cause failures after merge as the issues are for carrier legs created more than 30 days ago: ```sql select parcel_configuration_key, carrier_leg_sequence_number, count(*) as count_carrier_legs, max(carrier_leg_created_at) as latest_carrier_leg_created_at, from `dv-vgo-gen-prod.dimensional_prep.int_carrier_legs_prep` where carrier_code is null and date(carrier_leg_created_at) between '2024-01-01' and date_sub(date(current_timestamp()), interval 30 day) group by all order by count_carrier_legs desc ``` -- > [!NOTE] > there is a revision in the design, this test will now be implemented in `vgo_finance` instead. this test will be implemented on `mart_prep_shipment_legs_invoice_cost_and_revenue`, where the information is first being read. it will only look back at shipments created in the last 7 days. # To do list _If applicable, manual actions that need to be done before or after merging (e.g. manual `--full-refresh`)._ # Checklist _Fill out only the sections applicable to the PR.    a. `test_failures` models, which currently have a separate DAG for it, should continue to be excluded and kept seperate. (suggest to add a `tag: test_failures`)

3. lookml will be replicated: to create models based on the new names, which will be a replica of the lookml views for the old models, only with a change in the model name and source table.

details as ( select case when upper(trim(from_country)) in ('SE', 'FI', 'DK', 'PL', 'DE', 'US') then upper(trim(from_country)) -- to map swedish names to ISO 3166 Alpha-2 codes (e.g. SE, DK, DE) when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'DANMARK' then 'DK' when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'FINLAND' then 'FI' when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'FRANKRIKE' then 'FR' when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'LIBERIA' = 'TYSKLAND' then 'DE' when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'EJ ALLOKERAD' then 'Others' when upper(trim(from_country)) = 'ÖVRIGA LÄNDER' then 'Others' end as from_country_v2, case when # Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

see context in [VGOFIN-596](https://vinted.atlassian.net/browse/VGOFIN-596)

* this [slack message](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C059T9KAF8X/p1729247878603939?thread_ts=1729165673.045659&cid=C059T9KAF8X) is the original source of the discussion.
* `dbt docs generate`, which is used to derive artefacts used by the lookml generator is limited to layers which should be exposed.
* a conscious decision was made to limit this to dimensions, facts, marts, and aggregates in the interest of standardisation. (see [PR in github workflows](https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-github-workflows/pull/1284/files))
* other schemas will not be supported.

>[!NOTE]
> see this [google colab notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1umdbIOpxN5hyegrqGG_4UB_U1h3ZXfrD#scrollTo=07P5oc2JKESQ) for a check on the names.

therefore:

* to remove non-conforming schemas (e.g. in vgo_finance, this is marts_snapshot and test_failures) - this ticket.
  * the lookml code for these tables will still exist, but they will not be part of the scope of the auto-generation.
  * they will need to be replaced.

* as `fct_processed_shipments` is a large table, there's a motivation to reduce the size of this table for querying such that it does not scan the full table. (only d2c records `customer_id = 12` are needed.

```sql
  where shipment_created_at >= "2024-01-01"
  and customer_id = 12
```

reviews.body: Left some comments!
left more comment. probably coudn't we make the downstream model as incremental?

Hi, I have some reservations about this:
1. it's a mart that you plan to import in vgo_finance? Let's not do that. Only facts and dimensions, please. We already have too many mart imports and it's going to be a mess when we have to pay back that tech debt to properly orchestrate all DAGs (in some months from now).
2. Have you considered alternatives to optimise the cost of querying? E.g., apply clustering to the existing fact on `customer_id`? 
3. D2C is only a thing since last year, thus you can blatantly apply a date filter with some start date, which would already reduce the cost quite a bit
4. How often do you expect this table to be queried? Who will use it? Why create a completely new table with many columns if we know people don't need most of them? (e.g. D2C doesn't have verification so all of [these](https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-dbt/pull/2484/files#diff-7c4bcae9cf4bb78bcf313e609e273f900b039a7d12d70c3031b8363271791ff4R56-R60) fields will be FALSE or NULL) 
5. If you really need to use this proposed approach, did you consider creating the mart (or a mart_prep, if it's an intermediate step) in the final data space (vgo_finance or vgo_d2c)? This way you preserve the lineage rules by only importing a fact, and you yourself maintain whatever you need to do with the data. I don't fully understand why Network should maintain such a mart if the data won't be used by Network colleagues directly.

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

see the following threads for more context:
* in [vintedgo-analytics-engineering](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C03PBKAL1K2/p1726213839743559), for discussions on which table should be used.
* in [vintedgo-network-dsa-public](https://vinted.slack.com/archives/C070XCLHARL/p1725955550241649), for examples on where this information might be used.

main points:
* group finance wants data on pick-up point country.
   * this is being used to report on the shipment's `to_country_code`. it is part of a transformation logic which priortises taking the pick-up point country, then to address' country, then the user's (buyer's) country.
* as this joins directly with a table from marketplace's svc, there is no opposition to using `dim_shipping_points` to join with the information. these are examples of where it will be used:

> col ref marketplace: https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-marketplace-dbt/blob/main/transactional_experience/models/facts/shipments/fct_shipments.sql#L74
> Same thing in current dwh: [https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/blob/master/spark/src/main/scala/vinted/w[…]jobs/transactionalexperience/dimensions/ShipmentDimension.scala](https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/blob/master/spark/src/main/scala/vinted/warehouse/jobs/transactionalexperience/dimensions/ShipmentDimension.scala#L115-L128)

the questions to be addressed:

> let’s first examine cases where “pick-up point country code” is not equals to “shipment country code”. 
>
> * if this works out to be a material amount of information, then we should consider using this workaround (of using pick-up point, to address, etc.) to populate the to_country.
> * otherwise, i propose that in the DV, we do not model the logic similarly; that we rely solely on the to_country from shipment_legs_customer_invoices as the one source of truth for reporting.

prs.description:
# Summary [Required]
_What & why is being changed. If applicable, how the change was validated & tested. Add links to Jira, PRs, Slack, Lucid, etc., if relevant._

* follow up from https://github.com/vinted/dataverse-vintedgo-dbt/pull/2350

this PR:

* introduces a table showing the fallback price list joins (unique on the shipment_carrier_leg_id and carrier_contract_price_id).
   * this table only keeps the rows which have the highest number of matches for each shipment_carrier_leg_id
   * replaces CTE `fallback_prices_first_leg`, `fallback_prices_second_leg`, `fallback_prices`, `fallback_prices_max_joining_columns`.

see results in [bigquery](https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery?ws=!1m5!1m4!4m3!1sdv-vgo-fin-sb!2smarts_prep!3smart_prep_shipment_legs_price_list_joins_fallback_match) (only contains shipment carrier legs created after 2024-08-20):
```
select *
from `dv-vgo-fin-sb.marts_prep.mart_prep_shipment_legs_price_list_joins_fallback_match`
```

* introduces a table which summarises, on a `shipment_carrier_leg_id` level, the contract carrier price list join.
   *  replaces CTE `avg_fallback_price_max_joining_columns`

incidental to this PR:

* logic for rounding backend weight ranges is shifted upstream (as multiple tables call it)
* materialise `mart_prep_shipment_legs_price_list_joins_exact_match_shipment_leg_granularity` as table (as it will be called several times)
* expose join keys in `mart_prep_shipment_legs_price_list_joins_exact_match_shipment_leg_granularity` (as this is used downstream, and passing the information is preferred over joining the information again)
* expose `selling_price_currency` in the exact match models, as this is needed for the `fallback price` model

motivation:

in this PR:
