prs.title: HVF Actual vs Targets
prs.description:
_Growth: Domain_

Creates a model for Actual vs Targets comparisons.

For prior PRs raised for:
* Actual Aggregates: https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/pull/12569
* Target Imports: https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/pull/12553

The following metrics from targets are implemented:

```
    def mapMetricNameUDF = udf((value: String) => value match {

        case "pSTR30d"                         => "sell_through_rate_30d"               // calculated measure
        case "aSLV"                            => "average_sold_listings_value"         // calculated measure

        case "Eligible Listings"               => "total_listings_ovs_eligible"         // listingMonthlyAgg
        case "Listings"                        => "total_listings_hvf"                  // listingMonthlyAgg

        case "GMV"                             => "gmv_hvf_excl_refunds_eur"            // itemSaleMonthlyAgg
        case "Sold eligible escrow items"      => "sold_items_ovs_eligible"             // itemSaleMonthlyAgg
        case "Sold Items"                      => "sold_items_hvf"                      // itemSaleMonthlyAgg
        case "Total items verified (accepted)" => "sold_items_with_ovs_excl_rejections" // itemSaleMonthlyAgg
        case "Total items verified (all)"      => "sold_items_with_ovs_incl_rejections" // itemSaleMonthlyAgg

        case "VC GMV"                          => "gmv_vestiaire_collective"            // competitive data
        case "Vestiaire Collective Listings"   => "total_listings_vestiaire_collective" // competitive data
        case "HVF Market Listings"             => "total_listings_hvf_market"           // competitive data
        
        case _                                 => value                                 // for exception handling
    })
```

note: for calculated measures, the corresponding additive measure will be calculated in reverse. for example, the targeted `listings_sold_within_30_days` is calculated by taking `total_listings_hvf * sell_through_rate_30d`. this is done for all ratio-based measures such that when exposed to looker, the calculations can be done properly.

competitive data will be implemented in another PR as this requires import of data from GCP.
prs.author: jeremychia

reviews.body: Amazing Jeremy!! :)

prs.title: HVF Users Dim: Sequence, First Listing/Purchase Price Additions
prs.description:
_Domain: Growth_

This PR does the following:

(1)

**Logic dependency refactoring**: Since logic on whether an item is HVF is now in `HighValueFashionItemDimension`, the logic will be taken from there instead of having the logic written in this job.

(2) 

**New dimensions**: The following dimensions will be added:

* `sequence_first_hvf_listing`: The order in which the first high-value fashion listing appears among all listings of the user.

* `sequence_first_hvf_purchase`: The order in which the user's first high-value fashion purchase appears among all their purchases.

* `first_hvf_original_listing_price_eur`: The **initial listing price of the item**, in Euros, translated at the spot rate, of the first high-value fashion listing of the user.

* `first_hvf_purchase_price_eur`: The **selling price (i.e. GMV)**, in Euros, translated at the spot rate, of the first high-value fashion purchase of the user. _Note: There are users which have a first HVF purchase price below the threshold of 100EUR, because an item is currently considered HVF if it had an initial listing price (on listing creation) of 100 EUR or more._

More on definitions in this [Google Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YXNs7L4OamMvcLeS3X-1gqOp6aBJdmtaIOAMsap7S7Y/edit).

These new dimensions will be exposed downstream in `UserAllDimsDimension` and in Looker via https://github.com/vinted/lookml/pull/2347.
prs.author: jeremychia

prs.title: Adds currency translations in ItemImportedDimension + cucumberTest
prs.description:
_Domain: Growth_

As discussed in https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/pull/11903#discussion_r1371814959, it was agreed that there should only be one place where the transformations for translation to EUR should happen.

[1]

As multiple downstream jobs which extract information on the translated EUR prices, this calculation is brought upstream to `ItemImportedDimension`. The downstream jobs are:

* `ItemDimension`
* `ListingFact`: ~~however, to determine if Prices are needed in this job~~. This is needed to be retained because it is used downstream in some jobs, e.g. `ItemFunnelBatchView`.
* `HighValueFashionItemDimension`: to be created in https://github.com/vinted/warehouse-jobs/pull/11939.

[2]

Due to the renaming of `price_eur_fixed` to `listing_price_eur_fixed` for clarity, changes for the following jobs are also needed:
* `ReportsEnrichedFact`: one reference to `price_eur_fixed`. Final naming in the table is kept.
* `BuyerDebitProcessingEnrichedFact`: one reference to `price_eur_fixed`. Final naming in the table is kept.
* `PackageWeightFact`: one reference to `price_eur_fixed`. Final naming in the table is kept.

Follows up changes in: https://github.com/vinted/lookml/pull/2230.
prs.author: jeremychia

prs.title: Adding price groups based on EUR spot rates in ItemDimension
prs.description:
_Domain: Growth_

On `ItemDimension`, there is currently a field `detailed_price_group` which uses `price_eur_fixed` (item listing price, translated to EUR at a fixed rate) to categorise items into several price groups. This is an imperfect dimension as exchange rates of some currencies to EUR have changed. Using the spot rate, (i.e. `price_eur`) will give a more meaningful categorisation of the prices in EUR for markets where the functional currency is not EUR (e.g. HU, PL, SE, DK, etc.).

This PR:

* Adds price groups with the suffix `_eur_spot_rate` to denote these changes.
* Does the same for latest listing prices - in fixed EUR exchange rates, and using spot exchange rates.

For more information, see refinement ([Google Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TCnvRtTEx1h3NiiSCuOFzwXNQcgH6ISRuP0P1nWauCE/edit)).
prs.author: jeremychia
